agent.label: AI Agent
agent.description: Agente de IA con soporte multi-proveedor y herramientas basadas en workflows.

model.title: Modelo
model.description: ID del modelo. El frontend carga los modelos disponibles dinámicamente.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Mensaje del usuario (modo simple). Si se envía 'messages', este campo se ignora.

messages.title: Messages (Chat Mode)
messages.description: Historial de conversación [{role: 'user'|'assistant', content: '...'}]. Si se envía, tiene prioridad sobre 'prompt'.

tool_ids.title: Herramientas (Tools)
tool_ids.description: Endpoints marcados como tool (is_tool=true) que el agente puede invocar. Engine param: tool_ids (array of endpoint UUIDs). YAML authoring: write `tools: [<endpoint_name>, ...]` instead — the git-first codec resolves names ↔ UUIDs automatically on push/pull. Writing `tool_ids: [name]` in YAML bypasses the codec and fails at runtime with an invalid UUID.

session_id.title: Session ID
session_id.description: Unique conversation identifier. Typically passed from the frontend. Each session_id has its own memory.

memory_mode.title: Memory
memory_mode.description: How the agent remembers past conversations. 'Session' keeps history per session_id. 'User' remembers across all sessions for the same user.

tool_timeout.title: Tool Timeout (s)
tool_timeout.description: Tiempo máximo por tool call antes de abortarla.

memory_window.title: Memory Window (messages)
memory_window.description: Max number of recent messages to load (default 20).

output_schema.title: Output Schema (JSON)
output_schema.description: If set, the agent returns structured JSON matching this schema instead of free text. Uses generateObject() for guaranteed schema compliance. Example: {"type":"object","properties":{"sentiment":{"type":"string","enum":["positive","negative","neutral"]},"confidence":{"type":"number"}}}

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Instrucciones del sistema para el agente.

max_iterations.title: Máximo de Iteraciones
max_iterations.description: Número máximo de rondas de tool calling.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Máximo de tokens de salida. En DYPAI Managed se limita por plan.

memory_max_tokens.title: Memory Max Tokens
memory_max_tokens.description: Max tokens to load from memory (default 4000). Oldest messages are dropped first. This prevents long conversations from consuming the model's entire context window.

dypai_auth.label: DYPAI Auth
dypai_auth.description: Manage users: get info, update metadata, assign roles, ban/unban.

role.title: Role
role.description: Role name to assign (e.g., admin, editor, member).

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: Target user UUID. Use ${current_user_id} for the authenticated user.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Key-value pairs to set on user_metadata. Merges with existing values.

app_metadata.title: App Metadata
app_metadata.description: Key-value pairs to set on app_metadata. Use for plan, role, limits, feature flags. Merges with existing values.

ban_duration.title: Ban Duration
ban_duration.description: Duration of the ban (e.g., '24h', '7d', '876000h' for ~100 years). Default: permanent.

hubspot.label: HubSpot
hubspot.description: Manage contacts, companies, deals, and tickets in HubSpot CRM.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Search term (searches by email for contacts, name for companies).

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: JSON object of properties. Contacts: {"email":"...","firstname":"...","lastname":"..."}. Deals: {"dealname":"...","amount":"...","dealstage":"..."}.

discord.label: Discord
discord.description: Send messages, manage channels, and interact with Discord servers.

email_imap.label: Email (IMAP)
email_imap.description: Read, search, and manage emails via IMAP. Works with Gmail, Outlook, and any IMAP server.

uids.title: Email UIDs
uids.description: Comma-separated UIDs of emails to act on.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of emails to fetch.

mailbox.title: Mailbox / Folder
mailbox.description: Mailbox to read from. Use 'list_mailboxes' to see available folders.

since_date.title: Since Date
since_date.description: Only fetch emails received after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

destination.title: Destination Folder
destination.description: Target mailbox/folder to move emails to.

include_body.title: Include Body
include_body.description: Include the email body (text and HTML). Set to false for faster metadata-only fetch.

mark_as_read.title: Mark as Read After Fetching
mark_as_read.description: Automatically mark fetched emails as read.

email_smtp.label: Email (SMTP)
email_smtp.description: Send transactional emails via SMTP. Supports HTML, plain text, and custom headers.

from.title: From
from.description: Sender email address. Can include name: 'Name <email@example.com>'.

custom_headers.title: Custom Headers
custom_headers.description: Additional email headers as key-value JSON.

resend.label: Resend
resend.description: Envío de correos electrónicos transaccionales a través de la API de Resend.

from.title: From
from.description: Sender address. Format: Name <email> or just email.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Array of { name, value } objects for tracking.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Array of email objects with from, to, subject, html/text.

sendgrid.label: SendGrid (Twilio)
sendgrid.description: Send transactional emails and manage contacts and lists with SendGrid by Twilio.

slack.label: Slack
slack.description: Envía mensajes e interactúa con espacios de trabajo de Slack.

blocks.title: Block Kit JSON
blocks.description: Slack Block Kit blocks (overrides text for display).

thread_ts.title: Thread Timestamp
thread_ts.description: Reply in thread. Use message timestamp.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.description: Integración nativa de DYPAI con la API de Telegram para el envío de mensajes y archivos.

chatId.title: ID del Chat
chatId.description: ID del chat o nombre del canal (ej: @mi_canal o 12345678)

credential_id.title: Credenciales de Telegram
credential_id.description: Selecciona la credencial de Telegram (Bot Token) que deseas usar.

twilio.label: Twilio
twilio.description: Send SMS, MMS, WhatsApp messages and make voice calls via the Twilio API.

body.title: Message Body
body.description: The text content of the message. Not required when using a Content Template.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (max 1000).

twiml.title: Message / TwiML
twiml.description: Plain text message to say, or raw TwiML markup for advanced call flows.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to let the phone ring before giving up.

call_sid.title: Call SID
call_sid.description: The SID of the call to retrieve (CA...).

call_url.title: TwiML URL
call_url.description: URL returning TwiML instructions. If set, overrides the inline TwiML/message.

is_twiml.title: Input is TwiML
is_twiml.description: Enable if the message is already valid TwiML. Otherwise it will be wrapped in <Response><Say>...</Say></Response>.

media_url.title: Media URL
media_url.description: URL of media to include (MMS/WhatsApp). Must be publicly accessible.

content_sid.title: Content Template SID
content_sid.description: SID of an approved Content Template (HX...). Required for business-initiated WhatsApp conversations outside the 24h window.

message_sid.title: Message SID
message_sid.description: The SID of the message to retrieve (SM...).

status_callback.title: Status Callback URL
status_callback.description: Webhook URL to receive delivery status updates.

filter_date_sent.title: Date Sent
filter_date_sent.description: Filter by date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns messages/calls on this date.

content_variables.title: Content Variables
content_variables.description: JSON object with template variable values. E.g.: {"1": "John", "2": "your order #1234"}

machine_detection.title: Machine Detection
machine_detection.description: Detect if a machine answered the call.

messaging_service_sid.title: Messaging Service SID
messaging_service_sid.description: Send via a Messaging Service instead of a specific number. Overrides 'From'.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Integración nativa con la API de WhatsApp Business (Meta) para el envío de mensajes y multimedia.

to.title: Recipient Phone Number
to.description: Recipient phone number with country code.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Array of contact objects with name, phones, emails.

media_url.title: Media URL
media_url.description: Public URL of the media file.

datetime.label: DateTime
datetime.description: Format, parse, compare, and calculate dates and times.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date string (ISO 8601, Unix timestamp, or parseable format). Leave empty for current time.

add_value.title: Amount
add_value.description: Positive to add, negative to subtract.

custom_format.title: Custom Format
custom_format.description: Custom format using: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, SSS.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Filter arrays of data by conditions. Unlike If/Branch (control flow), this operates on data items.

items.title: Items
items.description: Array of items to filter. If empty, uses the previous node's output.

limit.title: Max Results
limit.description: Limit number of matching results. 0 = no limit.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Array of conditions. Each: { field, operator, value }. Operators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty, exists, not_exists.

expression.title: Filter Expression
expression.description: Expression that returns true to keep the item. Use 'item' for current value. E.g.: item.status === 'active'

return_discarded.title: Return Discarded Items
return_discarded.description: Also return items that didn't match in a separate 'discarded' array.

http_request.label: HTTP Request
http_request.description: Make HTTP requests to any external API.

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL to send the request to.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Custom headers as key-value JSON object.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Number of retry attempts (0-5). Only retries on 5xx/429/network errors.

body_json.title: Body (JSON)
body_json.description: JSON object to send as request body.

never_error.title: Never Error
never_error.description: Don't throw on non-2xx status codes. Return the error response as data.

query_params.title: Query Parameters
query_params.description: Query parameters as key-value JSON object.

full_response.title: Return Full Response
full_response.description: Include status code, headers, and status text in output.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries on mutating requests. Only applied to POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

pagination_data_path.title: Data Path
pagination_data_path.description: Dot-path to the array of items in the response (e.g. 'data', 'results').

pagination_max_pages.title: Max Pages
pagination_max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch (hard cap: 100).

pagination_param_name.title: Page/Offset Parameter
pagination_param_name.description: Query parameter name for the page number or offset.

pagination_next_url_path.title: Next URL Path
pagination_next_url_path.description: Dot-path to the next page URL in the response JSON.

javascript_code.label: JavaScript Code
javascript_code.description: Execute custom JavaScript code with full access to workflow context. Define a main(data, ctx) function.

code.title: JavaScript Code
code.description: Write a main(data, ctx) function. ctx provides: nodes (previous outputs), user (auth), env (custom vars). Supports async/await.

env_vars.title: Environment Variables
env_vars.description: Custom key-value pairs available as ctx.env inside your code. These are NOT system env vars.

input_data.title: Input Data
input_data.description: Data passed as first argument to main(). If empty, uses the previous node's output.

set_fields.label: Set / Map Fields
set_fields.description: Add, rename, remove, or transform fields on data objects without writing code.

field_list.title: Field Names
field_list.description: Comma-separated list of field names. E.g.: password, secret, internal_id

input_data.title: Input Data
input_data.description: Source object to transform. If empty, uses the previous node's output.

rename_map.title: Rename Mapping
rename_map.description: Mapping of old field names to new names. E.g.: { "old_name": "new_name" }

merge_object.title: Merge With
merge_object.description: Object to deep merge into the input data.

google_sheets.label: Google Sheets
google_sheets.description: Read, write, and manage Google Sheets spreadsheets.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Array of objects (keys = column headers) or array of arrays.

range.title: Range
range.description: A1 notation range. Leave empty to read all data.

header_row.title: First Row is Header
header_row.description: Use first row as property names for the output objects.

delete_sheet_id.title: Sheet ID
delete_sheet_id.description: Numeric sheet ID (from Get Spreadsheet Info).

notion.label: Notion
notion.description: Create, read, update, and search pages and databases in Notion.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Text to search for in page/database titles.

simplify.title: Simplify Output
simplify.description: Return simplified property values instead of raw Notion objects.

dypai_database.label: DYPAI Database
dypai_database.description: Acceso directo a la base de datos de tu proyecto DYPAI.

limit.title: Límite
limit.description: Número máximo de registros a devolver.

query.title: Query SQL
query.description: SQL query. Use ${input.field}, ${current_user_id}, ${nodes.x.y} placeholders. Bound as parameters with type-aware casts (uuid/jsonb/timestamptz auto-detected).

table.title: Table
table.description: Target table for the CRUD write.

where.title: Where (filters)
where.description: Column → value filters for update/delete. Combined with AND. REQUIRED for update and delete.

delete.title: Delete (true)
delete.description: Set to true to delete rows matching `where`. Mutually exclusive with insert/update.

insert.title: Insert (object or array)
insert.description: Column → value pairs to insert. Use an array for bulk insert. Mutually exclusive with update/delete.

params.title: Query params
params.description: Extra key/value pairs available as ${params.X} inside the query.

update.title: Update (object)
update.description: Column → value pairs to update. Requires `where`. Mutually exclusive with insert/delete.

returning.title: Returning
returning.description: Columns to return after mutation. Default '*' (all). Pass 'id' or 'id, name' to limit.

on_conflict.title: On conflict (upsert)
on_conflict.description: Optional. Set { columns: ['id'], action: 'update' } to make insert behave as upsert.

github.label: GitHub
github.description: Manage repositories, issues, pull requests, and releases on GitHub.

linear.label: Linear
linear.description: Manage issues, projects, and teams in Linear.

shopify.label: Shopify
shopify.description: Manage products, orders, customers, and inventory on Shopify.

store.title: Store Name
store.description: Your Shopify store subdomain (e.g. 'my-store' from my-store.myshopify.com).

logic.label: Lógica
logic.description: Nodos de control de flujo: condicionales, retornos y ramificaciones.

cases.title: Casos
cases.description: Array de casos para el switch. Cada caso tiene value o condition.

response.title: Respuesta
response.description: Objeto JSON que se devuelve como respuesta del workflow.

condition.title: Condición
condition.description: Expresión que se evalúa como true/false.

switch_on.title: Variable de switch
switch_on.description: Valor que se compara contra los casos definidos.

polar.label: Polar
polar.description: Native DYPAI integration with Polar.sh for developer monetization: products, subscriptions, orders, customers, and checkout.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL that will receive webhook events

events.title: Events
events.description: Array of event types to subscribe to. Available: checkout.created, checkout.updated, checkout.expired, customer.created, customer.updated, customer.deleted, customer.state_changed, order.created, order.updated, order.paid, order.refunded, subscription.created, subscription.updated, subscription.active, subscription.canceled, subscription.uncanceled, subscription.revoked, subscription.past_due, refund.created, refund.updated, product.created, product.updated, benefit.created, benefit.updated, benefit_grant.created, benefit_grant.cycled, benefit_grant.updated, benefit_grant.revoked, organization.updated

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Array of price objects. Fixed price example: [{"amount_type": "fixed", "price_amount": 999, "price_currency": "usd"}]

products.title: Products
products.description: Array of product IDs to offer at checkout. The first one is selected by default. E.g. ["product-uuid-1"]

discount_id.title: Discount id
discount_id.description: ID of a discount to apply

success_url.title: Success url
success_url.description: Redirect URL after successful payment. Add {CHECKOUT_ID} to retrieve the session.

credential_id.title: Polar Credentials
credential_id.description: Select the Polar credential you want to use.

recurring_interval.title: Recurring interval
recurring_interval.description: Billing interval for subscriptions: "month" or "year". Leave empty for one-time purchases.

allow_discount_codes.title: Allow discount codes
allow_discount_codes.description: Allow the customer to enter discount codes

external_customer_id.title: External customer id
external_customer_id.description: Your system's customer ID (creates or links a Polar customer)

stripe.label: Stripe
stripe.description: Native DYPAI integration with the Stripe API for payment and customer management.

items.title: Items
items.description: Updated array of items with price IDs

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

source.title: Source
source.description: Payment source ID (e.g., card token or saved card ID)

status.title: Status
status.description: Filter by status (active, past_due, unpaid, canceled, incomplete, incomplete_expired, trialing, all)

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Whether to immediately capture the charge (defaults to true)

cancel_url.title: Cancel url
cancel_url.description: URL to redirect if customer cancels

success_url.title: Success url
success_url.description: URL to redirect after successful payment

credential_id.title: Stripe Credentials
credential_id.description: Select the Stripe credential you want to use.

receipt_email.title: Receipt email
receipt_email.description: Email address to send receipt to

customer_email.title: Customer email
customer_email.description: Pre-fill customer email on checkout page

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Optional key for safe retries on mutating Stripe requests. Stripe will treat repeated requests with the same key as the same operation.

paid_out_of_band.title: Paid out_of_band
paid_out_of_band.description: Mark invoice as paid out of band

amount_to_capture.title: Amount to_capture
amount_to_capture.description: Amount to capture in cents (defaults to full amount)

cancellation_reason.title: Cancellation reason
cancellation_reason.description: Reason for cancellation (duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, abandoned)

client_reference_id.title: Client reference_id
client_reference_id.description: Your internal reference ID (e.g., user ID)

airtable.label: Airtable
airtable.description: Create, read, update, and delete records in Airtable bases.

view.title: View
view.description: Name of the view to use.

formula.title: Filter Formula
formula.description: Airtable formula to filter records. E.g: {Status} = 'Active'

calendly.label: Calendly
calendly.description: Manage scheduled events, invitees, and event types in Calendly.

max_booking_time.title: Max Booking Time
max_booking_time.description: Max future days for the scheduling link.

trello.label: Trello
trello.description: Create, update, and manage Trello boards, lists, cards, labels, checklists, comments, and attachments.

card_id.title: Card ID or URL
card_id.description: Card ID or Trello card URL.

board_id.title: Board ID or URL
board_id.description: Board ID or Trello board URL.

member_id.title: Member ID
member_id.description: Trello member username or member ID.

comment_id.title: Comment ID
comment_id.description: ID of the Trello action for the comment.

list_archive.title: Archive
list_archive.description: True to archive, false to unarchive.

attachment_url.title: Attachment URL
attachment_url.description: URL of the file or link to attach.

dypai_storage.label: DYPAI Storage
dypai_storage.description: Unified node for uploading, downloading, reading, listing and deleting files in DYPAI storage.

prefix.description: Folder-like prefix for list, or upload destination prefix.

confirm.description: true verifies/registers a previously client-uploaded object.

content.description: Server-side upload content. Supports plain text or data:<mime>;base64,... strings.

download.description: For download: true forces attachment disposition.

entity_id.description: Optional application/entity id echoed back in upload results.

file_path.description: Required for upload. For download/read/delete, provide file_path or file_id.

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Required for signed upload prepare.

content_type.description: MIME type. Required for signed upload prepare; inferred for content uploads when possible.

storage_path.description: Physical path returned by signed upload prepare; used for confirm=true.

client_upload.description: true prepares a signed upload URL when content is omitted; false requires content.

expires_minutes.description: Signed download URL lifetime in minutes.

twilio_trigger.label: Twilio Trigger
twilio_trigger.description: Triggers the workflow when an SMS, WhatsApp message, or call is received via Twilio.
